annotations.title: Ask a licensed agent to call the person

description:
Hands the person over to a licensed insurance agent (לצדך), who calls them back by phone or WhatsApp to check their own policy. ONLY call this after the person explicitly asked to be contacted AND agreed that a licensed insurance agent may contact them (and may also offer them insurance). Never call it on your own initiative, never with details the person did not give you, and do not include medical details (diagnoses, conditions): describe only what they want checked. user_consent must be true.
מעביר את האדם לסוכן ביטוח בעל רישיון שיחזור אליו. רק אחרי שהאדם ביקש במפורש שיחזרו אליו והסכים. בלי פרטים רפואיים.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it

need.description: What they want checked, one or two sentences, no medical details (e.g. "רוצה לדעת אם יש לי מסלול מהיר ל-MRI בפוליסה של הראל")

phone.description: The person's Israeli phone number, as they gave it

test.description: The test or topic, if relevant

user_consent.description: true only if the person explicitly agreed to be contacted by a licensed insurance agent, who may also offer insurance.
